title: mockupSource
responsibility: Validate, read, and compose immutable HTML and CSS mockup artifacts.

inputs.name: MockupFailure.constructor.message
inputs.description: Explanation of a failed authoring, approval, or rendering operation.

inputs.name: mockupSource.notes
inputs.description: Stored design notes, possibly including the versioned mockup source marker.

inputs.name: mockupHtml.document
inputs.description: Static HTML body fragment and the CSS rules for one mockup state.

inputs.name: mockupHtml.projectCss
inputs.description: CSS from the referenced project stylesheets at the selected revision.

outputs.name: mockupMarker
outputs.description: Prefix identifying design notes that hold versioned mockup source.

outputs.name: beforeState
outputs.description: Prefix identifying the matched current implementation capture for a proposed state.

outputs.name: answerSchema
outputs.description: Validator for base documents and design options authored by Sonnet.

outputs.name: variationSchema
outputs.description: Validator for the additional widths and state documents authored by Haiku.

outputs.name: sourceSchema
outputs.description: Validator for stored mockup source and its renderer matrix.

outputs.name: mockupSource
outputs.description: Validated source and its capture matrix, or null for notes without a mockup marker.

outputs.name: mockupHtml
outputs.description: Standalone HTML document containing the recorded project styles and one design state.
